baseline.algorithm: SHA-256 per accessible regular file plus Git untracked path membership

scope_note: Checks listed paths for untracked membership; accessible regular files are also checked by size and SHA-256. Detects newly appearing untracked paths under watch_roots. Classification is based on path, filename, extension and limited metadata, not a full semantic or provenance audit. The reserved Windows path nul is presence-only because normal file APIs cannot stat/open it.
